choices.why: Its clean, low-armed, deep-seat silhouette in a soft greige fabric is the most serene, japandi-like option and fits the right wall without overwhelming the room.
The textured rug in ivory and earthy brown reads as natural fiber and stays neutral, unlike the blue, colorful or kids' options.
It is the only round wooden coffee table, and its warm whitewashed wood and handcrafted texture suit a calm japandi palette.
The white pleated shade has the soft paper-lantern glow the user wants, in a floor-standing form that fits the corner beside the sofa.
The tall areca palm gives the large green accent asked for by the balcony glass, while the ceramic planter on offer is too small to hold it.

answer.why: A low greige sofa, a natural-toned textured rug, a warm round wood table, a soft white lantern-style lamp and one tall palm keep the room sparse and neutral. Together they create a serene japandi living room that works with the dark floors and the bright windows.
